name: FXSettlement
description: Settlement record for an FX spot trade. Created by SVC-007 (Treasury Services) at PH-063 when value_date (T+2) is reached and settlement is initiated. Tracks the status of both the buy leg (buy_currency credited to client) and the sell leg (sell_currency debited from client) through to final settlement confirmation received from SVC-010 (International Payments, CAP-003). The settled_at and swift_settlement_ref fields are derived from EVT-088 (FXSettlementCompleted) payload, as SVC-010 is the authoritative source for nostro settlement confirmation. Introduced by JRN-014.
owning_capability: CAP-002 (Commercial Banking — Treasury Services, CAP-002.04 PROMOTED)

fields.name: trade_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → FXTrade.trade_id (ENT-040). One-to-one relationship. Immutable.

fields.name: buy_leg_nostro
fields.validation_rule: Required. SWIFT BIC (8 or 11 characters) of the bank's nostro account in the buy_currency. Sourced from the bank's nostro account registry for the buy_currency at time of settlement initiation.

fields.name: sell_leg_nostro
fields.validation_rule: Required. SWIFT BIC (8 or 11 characters) of the bank's nostro account in the sell_currency. Sourced from the bank's nostro account registry for the sell_currency.

fields.name: settlement_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | initiated | sanctions_hold | failed | settled. Transitions: pending → initiated (EVT-087 published to CAP-003); initiated → settled (EVT-088 received from CAP-003); initiated → sanctions_hold (sanctions hit notification from CAP-005); initiated → failed (nostro settlement failed).

fields.name: settled_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Populated when settlement_status = settled. Sourced from EVT-088 payload. Immutable.

fields.name: swift_settlement_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. SWIFT transaction reference from MT300 / pacs.009 settlement message. 16-character SWIFT TRN. Populated when settlement_status = settled.
fields.derived_from: EVT-088 (FXSettlementCompleted) payload.swift_settlement_ref from SVC-010 SWIFT messaging layer

relationships.description: FXSettlement belongs to one FXTrade via trade_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: settled_at and swift_settlement_ref are derived from EVT-088 (FXSettlementCompleted) payload from SVC-010 (CAP-003).
design_decisions.rationale: SVC-010 (CAP-003) owns the nostro settlement execution and is the authoritative source. SVC-007 receives confirmation via EVT-088 and populates these fields from the event payload. Clean capability ownership is maintained — SVC-007 trusts the event from the owning service.

design_decisions.decision: settlement_status = sanctions_hold is a terminal state requiring MLRO resolution, not automated retry.
design_decisions.rationale: An OFSI sanctions hit is a regulatory event requiring mandatory MLRO review. Fail-closed: settlement_status remains sanctions_hold until explicit MLRO authorisation received. Satisfies GOV-005-R02 and POCA 2002 tipping-off obligations.
